Lemma
[Euclidean Green kernel identities] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0406, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0407 ↗ def:chow-ii-euclidean-green-function 1. appe:1.2\group Green Functions

For $x\ne y$ and $n\ge 3$, $\Delta _x\Gamma =\Delta _y\Gamma =0$, while \[ |\partial _{x^i}\Gamma |\le (n\omega _n)^{-1}|x-y|^{1-n}, \quad |\partial _{x^i}\partial _{x^j}\Gamma |\le \omega _n^{-1}|x-y|^{-n}. \]
